Rustic Modern Farmhouse 8 Inch Door Pulls

text.description_html:
Emtek 86439, 8 Inch Farmhouse Door Handle

The Farmhouse Door Pull combines the sleek lines of modern decor with the warmth of rustic hardware. This Modern Rustic 8 Inch Door Pull is available in matte black, medium bronze, and tumbled white bronze finishes. The 8 Inch Farmhouse Door Handle will fit doors up to 1-3/4 inches thick and comes packaged with everything you'll need to thru-bolt mount it on a wood, fiberglass, or metal door.

Sandcasting is a process for casting metal in sand molds. The mold is made by packing the sand around a pattern. Molten bronze is then poured into a mold cavity formed out of sand. Each sand mold is used only once. The sand is then recycled for the next piece.

Thru-Bolted Mounting: Pull bolts through the door.

Also Available: Farmhouse Pull with Back-to-Back Mounting

Specifications of the Emtek Rustic Modern Sandcast Bronze Pull:

  • Material: Sandcast Bronze
  • Total Length: 8-1/2"
  • Center to Center Length: 8"
  • Pull Handle Width: 1"
  • Total Projection: 2-1/2"
  • Base: 13/16"
  • Door Thickness: for doors up to 1-3/4" thick
  • Includes installation hardware required for fiberglass, wood, and metal doors.
  • Comes packaged with (2) 1" long 1/4"-20 screws, (2) 1" long #10-32 screws, (2) 2" #10-32 screws, and (2) screw caps.

Sold individually with thru-bolt mounting.
